note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. No risk finding could be established or excluded: research was not completed. Tooling failure during this run — DuckDuckGo/searx backend returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts; Google returned HTTP 429; DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint timed out twice; Bing returned only generic Rolex watch-brand results for every query (including the exact-PAN query 'AACCR5131Q' and the quoted 'Rolex Logistics Private Limited' + Indore query), i.e. the query terms were not honoured, so no usable hits; zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; OFAC Sanctions List Search page loaded but is a JS form and could not be queried via http_get. Therefore: sanctions_hit = null (NOT a negative screening result — OFAC SDN/consolidated, UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were not actually screened); court_cases = null (no eCourts/NCLT/High Court search performed); rating = null (no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Brickwork lookup performed); news_risk = null (no negative-news sweep performed); rf_supply = null (no evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS found, but no trade/tender/customs source was checked). Per project rules these nulls must not be read as 'clean' and must not be used as a rejection ground; the company stays in the base. Recommend re-running this company once the search backend is restored, with explicit checks against the OFAC SDN/consolidated list, EU consolidated list, UK OFSI list, BIS Entity List, eCourts/NCLT by the claimed PAN AACCR5131Q, and credit-rating agency databases. Note also that the claimed PAN and state (Madhya Pradesh) are unverified inputs from the batch file, not confirmed facts.
